# Copilot Instructions

## Frontend visual design guidance

Use the installed Taste Skill at `.agents/skills/design-taste-frontend/SKILL.md` as guidance for frontend design tasks.

- Avoid generic AI-looking layouts and repeated template patterns.
- Improve typography, spacing, hierarchy, and visual rhythm intentionally.
- Avoid repetitive centered hero plus three-card layouts unless the brief explicitly requires it.
- Preserve existing product functionality, routes, APIs, and behavior.
- Audit existing UI before redesigning, then improve what matters most.
- Make specific, code-level improvements, not vague design suggestions.
